context: The binary search trees in this book do not store duplicates. At every node, all values in its left subtree are smaller than its value, and all values in its right subtree are larger.

Insert 16 into the tree rooted at 8 that contains values 1 through 15. The figure shows the tree before and after insertion, and the table compares the connections side by side. “Empty” means there is no child. “Not yet added” means the node did not exist at that stage.
description: The first animation step corresponds to the two before-insertion columns of the connection table, and the last step corresponds to the two after-insertion columns. Use the node row headings to look up the connections in either state.
prose.result: After insertion, the tree contains values 1 through 16 and still satisfies the search ordering. Once cur becomes None, it cannot lead back to the parent, so pre must retain a reference to the last non-null node.

steps.announcement: Follow the right branch to the empty right child position of 15. There cur becomes None.
steps.explanation: The value 16 is greater than 8, 12, 14, and 15 along the search path 8→12→14→15→None. Now cur is None, pre points to 15, and node 16 has yet to be added. For all connections, see the two before-insertion columns in “Binary search tree connections before and after insertion.” Node 14 has left child 13 and right child 15. Both children of 15 are empty.
steps.key_state: With pre = 15 and cur = None, the empty right child position of 15 has been found.
steps.title: Find the empty right child position

steps.announcement: Point parent 15's right pointer to new leaf 16 to complete the insertion.
steps.explanation: Create leaf 16 and set pre.right to the new node. The pointer pre points to 15, and 14 still has left child 13 and right child 15. Node 15 has no left child and has right child 16. Both children of 16 are empty. All other connections stay the same. The two after-insertion columns of the same table show the whole tree. Since 16 is greater than all its ancestors on the path, the search ordering still holds.
steps.key_state: 15.right points to new leaf 16, and the tree contains values 1 through 16.
steps.title: Attach new leaf 16

prose.summary: Compare values on the way down until you reach a null reference. Use the parent pointer pre to attach the new leaf to the tree.
